comparison.objective: Remove a cap and connect an M12 cable while holding a loose sensor against coupling-ring drag; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires cap handling, connector alignment, thread engagement, bimanual counter-holding, and coupling-ring rotation. Candidate requires fine hex insertion, captive-screw loosening, collar rotation, socket reacquisition after motion, relocking, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the cap in a tray, connector tight, sensor stable, hands released, and arms returned. Candidate requires retained adjustment and two safe dynamic stop cycles within energy, travel, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Rotary locking and stabilization are shared primitives, but connector mating versus closed-loop shock-absorber commissioning are materially different objectives and outcomes.
